info.title: One Health Lyme Gap Atlas API
info.summary: Governed Atlas analytics, metadata, and provenance
info.description:
Read-only structured data from the One Health Lyme Gap Atlas.
Ordinary public reads are anonymous and require no API key.

## Interpretation and reproducibility
V1 (`/v1`) is the HTTP contract version; the application version is separate.
Read source, methodology, semantic/release versions, and limitations together.
Surveillance floors and gap scores are not diagnoses, individual risk estimates,
or causal claims. Null, zero, suppressed values, and no linked records have
distinct meanings. Response time is not publisher freshness.

## Queries and errors
Canonical collections use `data`, `meta`, and `links`; details use `data`.
Pagination defaults to 100 items (maximum 500). Send opaque `next_page_token`
as `page_token` with the same filters; null means exhaustion. Tokens bind to
query/release and may expire on restart. Current-release observations require
one measure, 1–500 county FIPS IDs, and a year or complete inclusive date range.
The default pre-execution logical-result ceiling is 10,000, not truncation.
Only the annual 2023 period is currently published; no strata are supported.

Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with `request_id` for support.
Canonical errors carry stable `code` values; legacy Atlas routes retain their
existing error semantics (including 422 validation). Respect `Retry-After` on
429/503. Canonical metadata/observations cache for 60 seconds; supported detail
resources return ETags and 304 on matching `If-None-Match`. See each operation
for legacy cache and export behavior.

## Contract consumers
Fumadocs, `/docs`, and `/redoc` consume the canonical public `openapi.json`
at `/openapi.json`. Internal product operations are not part of this contract.
Existing operation IDs remain stable for
generated clients. Breaking public changes require an approved migration and
deprecation plan; optional additive fields may appear within V1.
Only separately approved ML outputs may be published. Internal conversational
AI, literature retrieval, account, and feedback product routes are excluded.

get.description: PDF attachment. The default template is county-v3, the two-page County Data Brief for the published gap score and Explorer follow-up. county-v3 ignores score-setting overrides, so a What-if request cannot change the published score, response category, recommendations, or questions. Explicit county-v1 remains the immutable legacy county report and still binds score settings. Optional dataset_version selects a release. Opt-in county-v2 requires dataset_version, period_start, period_end and repeated measure_id (1–20, repeated or comma-separated); reads canonical evidence, lineage, value states and limitations. Missing or mismatched provenance returns 503; unknown observations return 404. county-v1 and county-v3 reject observation selectors with 422. V2 responses use no-store and revalidate authoritative context before cache/304. ETag/If-None-Match supports 304; published briefs use public cache TTL 300 seconds with revalidation. Unknown templates return 422; resource limits 413; renderer failure/timeout 503.

get.summary: Get both persisted county surveillance-situation classifications
get.description: Primary four_state includes human surveillance; secondary tick_pathogen excludes it. Returns reviewed labels, four membership probabilities per model (0-1, sum 1 within 1e-6), immutable model/batch lineage, source vintages and interpretation limits. Unknown is an available class; No records does not establish absence. Membership is not disease risk, incidence, pathogen presence, causation or Tier 1 priority. HTTP 200 can contain typed UNAVAILABLE variants with null data, including an incompatible release. Unknown county 404; malformed FIPS 422; dependency, malformed persisted data or changing release 503. Cache-Control: no-store; no fallback or inference.

get.summary: Get persisted Tier 1 model-assisted surveillance review priority
get.description: Returns the approved persisted county result from the current Tier 1 batch. This is surveillance review priority, not Lyme disease risk, predicted incidence, probability, clinical risk, or diagnosis. LOW is a scored tier; evidence sufficiency is separate. Percentile is relative to the scored batch and population. A county without a persisted result returns 404; an unavailable current view or malformed result returns 503. Public cache TTL 60 seconds; generated_at_utc is the model batch time, not request time.

get.summary: Get Tier 1 result availability and persisted data
get.description: Additive availability contract for current supported county geographies. A successful lookup returns AVAILABLE with the exact persisted result, or UNAVAILABLE with reason NO_PUBLISHED_MODEL and null data after the current geography release and Tier 1 projection have both been read successfully. geography_release_id identifies the release used to validate the FIPS. This endpoint does not turn null into zero or synthesize model output. NOT_ESTIMABLE is a persisted result state and is distinct from no published model result. Malformed FIPS returns 422; an identity outside the current geography release returns typed 404; dependency or malformed-data failures return 503. Public cache TTL 60 seconds.

get.summary: Check canonical county geography publication availability
get.description: Additive county-only operation. Confirms membership and release from the governed county directory before returning UNAVAILABLE/CANONICAL_GEOGRAPHY_UNPUBLISHED with null data. The canonical resource is identity metadata, not a polygon. No geometry is returned or inferred. State availability is unsupported (400). Malformed county IDs return 400; confirmed absent identities return 404. Unavailable, empty, duplicate or inconsistent directory authority remains 503. The directory uses the existing bounded snapshot cache, checked against a fresh current-release lookup; a mismatch remains 503. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store. The existing canonical resource route and county/map routes are unchanged.

get.description: Current published county observations only. Ordered by measure ID, county FIPS, period start, and observation ID. Opaque page tokens bind to filters and release. Annual surveillance uses 2023. Separately enabled, reviewed January 2025 environmental measures use labeled daily periods, carry environmental_context coverage, and have no supported strata. Environmental context is descriptive weather, with no causal, disease-risk or ML claim. Surveillance context is optional and requires an admitted Data delivery; normalized_state preserves Data semantics and the publisher value remains value. Separately enabled CDC status uses start_date=end_date=2025-12-31 and CUMULATIVE grain; scapularis_status and burgdorferi_status require exact Data record admission. Annual year and other date ranges return 400 UNSUPPORTED_FILTER before data access. Missing context does not establish absence or temporal comparability. County SVI/population/insurance context requires vintage_year=2022 and retains ACS 2018-2022 periods. RUCC requires vintage_year=2023 and returns categorical codes/labels with null period dates. These measures reject annual/day filters; absent rows are unavailable evidence, never zero. A measure and bounded county/time selection are required; no user sorting or aggregation. After successful release/measure/query reads, an initially empty non-CDC selection returns 200 with meta.availability=UNAVAILABLE and reason=NO_PUBLISHED_RESULTS. This does not establish source coverage or biological absence. Exhausted continuation pages remain AVAILABLE. CDC admission and operational errors remain non-2xx. Known unavailable collections use Cache-Control: no-store.
